sources_note: 全部实体取自 Roblox 官方公开接口(S 级):游戏描述 games.roblox.com、通行证 apis.roblox.com/game-passes(11 个,nextPageToken 空)、开发者商品 apis.roblox.com/developer-products v2(90 个,全量,nextPageCursor 为空;2026-10-10 05:20 UTC 读取)、官方活动 apis.roblox.com/virtual-events、群组 groups.roblox.com、分级 experience-guidelines-api。名称逐字复制接口 name/Name 字段(含大小写与方括号);唯一例外是接口里 'Dragon Egg ' 带尾随空格,name_en 去掉尾随空格,原值保留在 name_api_raw。11 个通行证与 90 个商品的官方描述全部为空,所以没有 description 字段;usage_en 只按名称归类,明写 effect/contents not published,不含任何倍率、数量、概率。徽章 0,未建实体。区域名、宠物名与倍率、蛋概率、Rebirth 门槛、World 解锁条件、兑换码无一手来源,未建实体。价格为 2026-10-10 快照;2 个未上架商品(Boost Bundle、Power Boost)接口无价格,不写 unlock_cost。通行证 order 按价格再按创建时间升序;商品 order 按创建时间再按价格升序。 活动实体不用 mog-evolution 的 deadline 字段(界面标签是「Claim deadline」,本活动没有可领取的东西,会误导),改记 event_start_utc / event_end_utc,这两个字段没有 f_ 标签,不渲染,起止时间已写在 key_notes_en。 2026-10-02 第 1 轮验证后:删掉 key_notes_en 里的「Private servers not allowed」(createVipServersAllowed=false 对已知有私服的游戏同样为 false,不能据此下结论,private_servers 记入 unverified_fields);活动实体 key_notes_en 补入两场过往官方活动;第 2 轮复验后其出处改为带游标的请求(?cursor=id_2zwAAAAAAAAAAzwAAAAAAAAAA,2026-10-02 实测 4/4 次返回 3 条);默认请求通常只返回即将开始的一条。 2026-10-10 D1 更正:3 个商品改价(Skill Multiplier [TIER 1] 3→5、Golden Skip 12→19、Diamond Skip 19→29),补 12 个 2026-10-03 之后创建的商品实体(order 接在原有之后);活动接口 2026-10-10 带游标返回 5 条、不带游标返回 2 条。
_page_slug_note: page_slug 指向 content/en 下实际存在的页。

stone-skipping.summary_en: Roblox incremental simulator: every bounce of a thrown stone gives +1 Skill, training and levelling up make you throw farther, farther zones pay more Wins, pets give boosts and Rebirth makes you stronger.
stone-skipping.description_en: Every bounce gives you +1 Skill! · Train and level up to throw farther! · Reach farther zones to earn more Wins! · Unlock better stones and unusual objects to throw... even a DONUT! · Collect pets for powerful boosts! · Rebirth to grow stronger and beat your longest throw!
stone-skipping.alt_name_en: +1 Skipping Stones (the name used in the first line of the official description)
stone-skipping.key_notes_en: 10 players per server · Maturity: Minimal · No badges · 11 game passes · 90 developer products (88 on sale)
stone-skipping.key_notes_repro: Maturity read anonymously on 2026-10-10: POST https://apis.roblox.com/experience-guidelines-api/experience-guidelines/get-age-recommendation with header content-type: application/json and body {"universeId":"10765298801"} returns ageRecommendation.displayName = Minimal.

event-admin-abuse-world-5.summary_en: Official Roblox event for +1 Stone Skipping hosted by the group Meow Labs, category 'new content'; the listing's description has three lines: Admin Abuse, World 5, New features.
event-admin-abuse-world-5.key_notes_en: Subtitle: FIRST ADMIN ABUSE!! · Listed start 3 October 2026, 16:00 UTC · Listed end 3 October 2026, 18:00 UTC (window ended) · Listed 26 September 2026 · Earlier official events: World 3 + New Content (20–23 September 2026) and WORLD 4 + UPDATE (27 September–1 October 2026) · Later listings read on 10 October 2026: WORLD 6 + ADMIN ABUSE (10–11 October 2026) and Halloween Event (17 October–1 November 2026)
event-admin-abuse-world-5.expiry_action: 2026-10-11 16:00 UTC: re-read the events API after the WORLD 6 + ADMIN ABUSE window; re-read both store lists
